description: This file defines the AuditLogService class responsible for handling audit log operations in the project. It interacts with an AuditLogRepository and NetworkService to insert audit log entries with client information.

classes.name: AuditLogService
classes.description: Service class for managing audit log insertions, utilizing other services and repositories within the project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: AuditLogRepository and NetworkService.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry with subject ID, action, object, context, and client info, returning the inserted record's ID.
